segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the quote we reviewed last week: 42 seats for the project management module, annual term, start date March 1. I just wanted to confirm the seat count and the invoice timing before I send it through deal desk.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, 42 is right for the first group. We may add another 8 or 10 in Q3, but for now I need the initial team covered. On invoicing, can you set it to bill on March 1 with net 30 terms?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, net 30 is already approved on your account. The annual amount is $31,080 before tax, and that includes onboarding. The onboarding is a one-time $2,400 line item, but it's bundled into that total on the pricing sheet.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that's what I have. Our finance team asked whether the renewal would auto-renew or if we get a notice first.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It does auto-renew for successive one-year terms, but the contract has a 60-day notice window. We also send a renewal reminder to the billing contact 90 days before the term ends.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Billing contact should be ap@northlineparts.com, and copy me on the first invoice. Also, can the go-live still be March 18?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: March 18 is still workable. If we get signature by Friday, February 16, our services team can start the kickoff on February 21 and keep the March 18 go-live date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should be fine. Legal already reviewed the order form, no redlines. I just need the final version with the updated billing email.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll update the billing contact in the CRM, generate the final order form, and send it over this afternoon. It'll come with the same $31,080 total and March 1 start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it to me and I'll route it for signature today.
